Solutions
Your Product data, reimagined.

Give your team a smarter way to work with product data-from attribution to insights. Harmonya connects product data to consumer reviews so you can act faster and compete smarter.

Demand Intelligence
Understand what's driving growth in your category. Surface the themes gaining and losing share, benchmark against competitors, and find the whitespace before the market moves.
Consumer Intelligence
Hear what consumers actually say about your products and your competitors, and connect that voice to the themes shaping demand across messaging, innovation, and positioning.
Attribute Intelligence
Know what's true about every product. Market and measured attributes enriched at the UPC level, from claims and ingredients to grams of protein, so every team works from the same product truth.
Product Catalog
Accurate, always-current product attribution across your schemas, taxonomies, and teams. Available as a Standard catalog or a Custom catalog maintained to your spec.

About Us
About Us

Why Harmonya

At Harmonya, we believe the future of commerce is powered by clarity, and great teams make that possible. Our work matters because it helps some of the world’s leading brands and retailers turn complexity into action. Here, your contributions don’t get lost in the noise, they drive impact.

Be part of a fast-learning, collaborative team

Work on real world problems with cutting-edge AI

Build products that help businesses make better decisions

Grow your skills in a supportive, transparent culture

How We Work

Our culture is defined by the way we treat each other and the work we do. It is not about perks (although ours are pretty great) or buzzwords. It is about trust, curiosity, and shared goals.

Relationships

We put people first. That includes our customers, our partners, and our teammates.

Growth and Excellence

We believe learning never stops. We encourage curiosity, feedback, and continuous improvement at every level.

Perseverance

Great work takes focus and resilience. We stay committed through complexity and keep moving forward together.

Humility

We listen carefully, stay open to new ideas, and learn from every challenge.

Benefits & Perks

We want you to do your best work and feel empowered and supported in all aspects of your life. That means offering benefits that matter.

Competitive healthcare & wellness plans (U.S.)

401k retirement benefits (U.S.)

Hybrid work arrangements (Israel)

Professional development and growth support

Flexible time off (U.S.)

Where We Work

Enjoy working from our New York or Tel Aviv offices or from the comfort of your home.

New York City

Our midtown location is home to go-to-market teams including sales, marketing, and customer success.

Tel Aviv

Our Israel HQ is where product, R&D, and data come together to make magic for our customers.

Remote

Our distributed team works from cities around the world, collaborating to build, create, and support our customers from anywhere.
